class.name: BulletEmitterData2D
class.brief_description: When and how flying bullets fire a template spawner's pattern (emitter bullets).
class.description: Emitter bullets fire while they fly: every bullet of a volley fires the whole pattern of a template spawner (any [PatternSpawner2D], normally with its own shooting off) on its own schedule. The template decides [i]what[/i] is fired (pattern, spawn data, homing, sound, graze, splits, even its own emitters); this resource decides [i]when[/i] (interval, start delay, a stagger per bullet index, a shot limit, a chance) and [i]which way[/i] (the bullet's flight heading, the world, or the template's rotation, plus a spin that grows with every shot for spirals). Use it from [member BulletSpawner2D.emitter] (with [member BulletSpawner2D.emitter_enabled] and [member BulletSpawner2D.emitter_spawner_path]) or on a factory volley with [method BulletVolley2D.emitter_set]. Volleys read the resource every tick, so edits reach bullets already in flight. Shots are recorded during the factory sweep and fired right after it; [member BulletFactory2D.emitter_max_shots_per_sweep] and [member BulletFactory2D.emitter_max_pending] bound how many fire per frame and wait. Every accepted change emits [signal Resource.changed].

members.member: Which way the fired pattern faces (see [enum EmitterAim]). Edits reach bullets in flight.
The chance (0 to 1) that a due shot fires. A missed shot still counts toward [member max_shots] and keeps the schedule. Rolled with [member seed].
When [code]true[/code], every shot inherits the emitting bullet's velocity (a still template bullet then flies along with the emitter bullet).

Seconds between two shots of one bullet, on the volley's clock (time scales apply). A bullet fires at most once per tick: after a hitch or a freeze the schedule moves on instead of firing a burst of missed shots. Must be finite and > 0.
How many shots each bullet fires per life at most. 0 (default) = no limit.
Seeds the [member chance] rolls (with the shot number and the bullet index, so successive shots differ). 0 uses Godot's global random generator.
Turns each shot further than the last: shot [code]k[/code] of a bullet is turned by [code]k * spin_per_shot_degrees[/code] (a spiral from every bullet). Must be finite.
Delays bullet [code]i[/code]'s first shot by [code]i * stagger_sec[/code] on top of [member start_delay_sec], so the bullets of a ring fire one after another. Must be finite and >= 0.
Seconds after the volley is armed (usually its spawn) before a bullet's first shot. 0 (default) fires on the first tick. Must be finite and >= 0.

constants.constant: The pattern is turned to the bullet's flight heading (its velocity, or its direction while still).
The pattern is not turned: the bullet is a moving muzzle.
The pattern is turned like the template spawner node (read when the shot fires).
